title: zai-org/ZCode
why_read: A new coding agent harness from Z.ai with meaningful GitHub traction, worth a glance for engineers tracking the crowded coding-agent tooling space.
analysis: ZCode is described as Z.ai's own harness for running coding agents, built in TypeScript, with over 6800 stars suggesting real community interest. The description is thin and marketing-heavy, so it's hard to tell what technically distinguishes it from the many other coding agent frameworks currently proliferating. Given the current glut of similar tools, this is worth a quick look but not clearly a must-read without more detail on its actual architecture or differentiation.
